name: Under the Sea
lore: The road dives under the waves, where octopuses play drums, deep-sea fish glow in the dark, volcanoes smoke on the sea floor, aliens drop by and old ships sail at night, with a sunny beach or two on the way.
sourceNote: FLUX.1 [schnell] by Black Forest Labs (Apache-2.0), 4-bit GGUF, run on the studio's Mac; lane C's full story scenes, 50 picks and 12 spares (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/08-under-the-sea/README.md, picks-full.json, workspace 04fac5c; 8 of the 50 edited for readability by lane C, each with an edit note on its manifest line and licence row). Kind painting, shade on, converted by land.js boardOf with the whole manifest line (chroma). The 62 manifest lines are lane C's, whole; lane D filled only the empty url with the licence row's source in Dino Valley's words (and, on the four parodies, the painting). The folder keeps lane C's slug (08); as installed it is Land 6 in the factory's numbering (levels 430-479, era 14) and Zen World 7.
eggNote: Eggs on the reused sheets' painted side-quest spur tips (World 1's, 5's and 6's rule; the land has no side quests): eggTurns puts each sheet's 2 eggs on its template's 2 quest spots, each repeat its own pair. Kinds that suit a sea floor: fish, bubble (a rising air bubble), glint (a sunken gem), reeds (kelp), wisp (a glowing jelly).

zen.note: v7 lane D: Under the Sea plays as Zen World 7 (tools/land.js ... zen writes tools/build-data/levels/zen.json only). Records keep the land factory numbers 430-479 (scratch/state.json seeded {from: 430, sheet0: 58, gal0: 62}: Worlds 1-6 hold 1-50, 201-250, 251-300, 301-350, 351-400, 401-429; World 6's sheets end at 57); the page shows them on from World 6's last Zen number (Zen 280-329, main.js zenNum); zen.numbered keys each licence row by its Zen picture number before its level.

profile.note: Zen World 7, casual (v7 lane D, 2026-10-12): Dino Valley's profile as it ships (tools/lands/05-dino-valley/land.json; AI full story scenes): tags E18/N26/H6/X0 ending on a Hard, ? cards, linked squads, gentle moats (2 ways in) on pictures that can carry one, no locks, no archers, no Extreme, no mystery blocks (Peter, 2026-10-08), careful floor 0.5 every tag, deal attempts 96 at the land-config squads. The trial (tools/land-08-notes.md, games b15e9e5) passed on it; World 5's 1.6x/400 deal not needed.

hidden.note: v6 lane D8 (Peter, 2026-10-08): no mystery blocks in Zen, ever. The whole picture shows from the start; land.js and zen-world.js refuse a Zen land or world with hidden in its features or a hidden share.

map.note: v7 lever 1: no new image bytes. The castle's sheets 14 and 15 (The Mistmoor: a marsh of pools and channels, the most water of any sheet left) reused through map.fromLayout, alternately mirrored, under a blue underwater tint (Peter, 2026-10-11; map.tint on every entry: the marsh turns a blue sea floor, the pools darker), clearly apart from World 5's sepia and World 6's pale blue-green. Not 2/5 (World 5's), 7/1 (World 6's) or 4/6 (earmarked for Water Lily Isle).
